id_and_class.summary: Paul and Patricia Churchland hold that common-sense psychology, our everyday talk of beliefs, desires, and experiences, is a radically false theory that a completed neuroscience will displace rather than smoothly reduce. Consciousness as we ordinarily conceive it is a brain-generated picture shaped by evolution, and our self-understanding, introspection included, will be rebuilt in neuroscientific terms.
id_and_class.core_identity_tagline: Folk Psychology as a False Theory Awaiting Replacement

conceptual_ground.explanatory_identity_claim: What we call consciousness, as folk psychology describes it, does not exist in that form. The real phenomena are neural processes, which only a mature neuroscience will describe correctly.
conceptual_ground.mind_body_relationship: The mind is the brain. Patricia Churchland calls her program a ‘unified theory of the mind-brain’ and treats claims that mind goes beyond brain as the residue of folk myths.
conceptual_ground.emergence_type: Not applicable (Patricia Churchland dismisses emergence as of little explanatory value; folk mental kinds are to be replaced, not explained as emergent)
conceptual_ground.subjectivity_and_intentionality: Paul Churchland expects even first-person introspection to be ‘reconstituted within the conceptual framework of completed neuroscience’. Beliefs and desires, the core of folk psychology, are candidates for elimination.
conceptual_ground.qualia_account: Qualia as folk psychology and philosophers conceive them are expected to give way to neuroscientific description; the view treats consciousness as a kind of illusion generated by the brain.
conceptual_ground.ontological_commitments: Neurons, brains, and the entities of physics, chemistry, and biology. No irreducible mental properties.
conceptual_ground.epistemic_access: Through neuroscience. Patricia Churchland rejects philosophy as an a priori discipline that could set limits on neuroscientific theory.
conceptual_ground.constituents_and_structure: Neural systems as described by neurobiology.

mechanism_and_dynamics.scope_of_consciousness: Folk psychology as a whole (belief, desire, experience, introspection); Phenomenal consciousness (as folk-conceived)
mechanism_and_dynamics.distinctive_mechanism_or_principle: Theory displacement. Folk psychology will be replaced the way outdated scientific theories were, its principles and ontology discarded rather than mapped onto brain states.
mechanism_and_dynamics.causation_and_functional_role: Behavior is caused by neural processes; neuroscience is expected to explain it better than folk psychology does.
mechanism_and_dynamics.evolutionary_account: Consciousness as we experience it is a contingent evolutionary adaptation that improved fitness and reproductive success.
core_claims_and_evidence: Paul Churchland defines eliminative materialism as the thesis that common-sense psychology is a radically false theory to be displaced by completed neuroscience.
Patricia Churchland’s Neurophilosophy places the mind-body problem within philosophy of science and calls for a neurobiological account of mind.
Neuroscience’s growing success with mental states, and philosophy’s loss of a priori authority, motivate the program.
Allied thinkers such as Daniel Dennett hold that only the scientific image, expressed in physics, chemistry, and neurophysiology, represents what exists in itself.
mechanism_and_dynamics.basis_of_belief_or_evidence_type: Philosophical, grounded in philosophy of science and the progress of neuroscience.

empirics_and_critiques.known_empirical_interventions_or_tests: The view stakes its claim on the future course of neuroscience; whether folk categories survive in mature brain science is the long-run test.
empirics_and_critiques.criticisms_and_tensions: Critics say denying subjective experience defies both intuition and direct evidence; Galen Strawson calls the denial of experience ‘the strangest thing that has ever happened in the whole history of human thought’. There is also tension between Patricia Churchland’s talk of reduction to neurobiology and the eliminativist claim that folk psychology will be displaced rather than reduced.
empirics_and_critiques.open_questions_and_limitations: How much of folk psychology will be eliminated, and what will replace introspective concepts, depends on a neuroscience that does not yet exist. The view is often caricatured as denying that thoughts and experiences occur at all.
empirics_and_critiques.ontological_coherence: Fully consistent with physicalism; it is the most thoroughgoing materialist position on the mind.

survival_beyond_death.rationale: Since the mind is the brain, nothing mental survives the brain’s death.

meaning_and_purpose.rationale: Patricia Churchland urges us to see ourselves as organisms in nature, understood by scientific methods, with no cosmic purpose.
